prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Minecraft 16x16 wand component texture atlas, transparent PNG.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Redraw its existing seven wand bases and eight detachable tips as much simpler, genuinely low resolution vanilla Minecraft item pixel art. Keep the material identities and unique crooked/knuckled/jointed silhouettes, but remove the noisy small highlights and busy checkerboard shading. This must look intentionally authored at 16x16, never like high-resolution pixel art shrunk down.

Exact atlas arrangement: four columns and four rows of equal square tiles. Row 1: wood, bamboo, bone, blaze. Row 2: breeze, end rod, copper lightning rod, empty tile. Row 3: amethyst tip, diamond tip, emerald tip, ender pearl tip. Row 4: copper tip, iron tip, ghast tear tip, netherite tip.
Each tile is a 16x16 logical pixel canvas, enlarged with nearest-neighbor square pixels. Make all logical pixels exactly the same size and aligned to the same grid. Use a 1024x1024 overall square canvas: each tile is 256x256; each logical pixel is a clean 16x16 square. No gridlines or labels.

For each base tile the bottom-left grip ends at logical (2,13), shaft follows a simple stair-step diagonal toward a common bare attachment at (11,4). Keep every opaque pixel inside logical x=1..14 and y=1..14; entire outside border is transparent. The attachment point is identical for all seven bases. Tips sit at that same upper-right attachment in their own 16x16 tile, occupying only about x=10..13,y=2..5, so they can overlay a base without moving it. Each tip also has a full transparent outside border. Tips are small, legible simple diamonds/caps/pearls with two or three shades, not detailed separate inventory gems.

Color/shading: only 3 coherent flat shades per shaft material, plus at most 2 gold binding shades on a short grip band. Connected highlights follow one side of the shaft, connected shadow follows the other side. Distinct material palette: warm brown wood, muted green bamboo, cream bone, orange/gold blaze, airy muted teal breeze, pale ivory with lavender end rod, reddish copper with a little muted teal patina for lightning. One short simple binding band per base. No checkerboard/dithering or isolated colored flecks; no multiple bands along shafts except two very subtle bamboo nodes.
No soft edges, no antialiasing, no gradients, no bloom, no outlines outside the logical grid, no baked shadows, no text, no UI. Background must be genuinely transparent.
production: Nondithered six-colour body/four-colour tip indexed export; each logical pixel uses the opaque-cell majority. Bodies occupy (1,4)..(12,14), tips (10,1)..(13,4) inside actual 16x16 RGBA layers. One clear pixel on every edge of all 63 composed appearances; no painting, blur or dithering. Threads unchanged.
